== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The unnumbered and numbered sheets show an unrestricted title and cap deployment at once per deploy phase. The Premium sheet keeps the cap in shorthand and prints a uniqueness dot in both title positions. The period rules retained the underlying unrestricted card’s uniqueness, and the Sai’torr entry specifically referred to Blaster Rack’s one weapon per copy per turn ruling. The 2006 slip again shows an unmarked title and replaces the explicit cap with the just-deployed-character trigger during your deploy phase. The matching-weapon, Reserve Deck, reshuffle and Alter immunity terms continue.
